text:
maria: Heads-up — starting our quarterly access skein/prune tomorrow. Need owner evidence for ~240 admin-like roles and a KMS grant verification pass. Rolling thread for fallout and triage. cc @alex @jordan

alex: On it. Can we run the ownership query and filter `last_login > 90d`? Want to reduce noise before manual review.

jordan: Quick scan finished earlier; I matched KMS grants against principals and got some cross-account hits. Dropping the automation snippets below.

jordan: ```
# GCP logging example
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="kms_key" protoPayload.methodName:"google.cloud.kms.v1.*"' --limit 1000

# AWS CloudTrail example
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=ResourceName,AttributeValue=arn:aws:kms:... --max-results 50
```

sam: If we remove roles, coordinate with oncall. Suggest `--stagger 24h` in the prune job so we don't kill prod traffic in a single wave.

maria: :thumbsup: Good call. For evidence collection use the access-evidence doc (internal link). We'll require: owner statement, last-used proof (logs), and KMS grant snapshot.

alex: Oddity: svcacct `redwood-analytics-job` shows KMS decrypt grants in two accounts. Could be intentional cross-account access or a stale grant. Anyone own that job?

sec-bot: Incident-bot: New finding flagged — cross-account KMS grant for `redwood-analytics-job` created 2025-12-02T11:03:12Z. Assigned to @maria.

maria: Assign accepted. Triage plan: 1) verify necessity; 2) if unnecessary, prepare removal + justification; 3) capture rollback plan. Will report back.

jordan: Sample CSV from quick scan (very small excerpt):
```
role,principal,last_activity,kms_grants
admin/project-a,svc:redwood-analytics-job,2024-03-01,none
admin/infra,team:deploy,2022-11-15,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/abc
admin/data,svc:etl-worker,2023-08-02,arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/def
```

sam: For automation: run a `--dry-run` that tags roles with `prune-candidate:YYYYMMDD` label and sends owner notifications. Don't actually revoke in the first pass. Add a CI whitelist for `ci/*` service accounts so pipeline roles don't get pruned.

maria: Proposed schedule: dry-run Wed 09:00 PT, owner emails Thu morning, removals start two weeks after ack. Who can own the dry-run?

alex: I can own the dry-run job. I'll open a PR to infra-auth: `remove-orphans --dry-run --label prune-20260301` and post results here.

jordan: I'll assemble an evidence bundle (CSV + KMS audit slices + sample logs) and push to secure bucket. Also adding an audit hook to post KMS grant changes to #incidents as ephemeral alerts linking tickets.

sam: One gotcha — changing roles referenced by CI or deploy agents will cause build failures. I'll add a precheck to detect refs in `ci/workflows` and `deploymanifests/`. If found, auto-notify owning team and skip prune for 7 days.

maria: Capturing action items: alex — run dry-run and PR, jordan — evidence bundle + audit hook, sam — precheck + CI whitelist, maria — triage cross-account KMS grant and draft emails.

sec-bot: Reminder: upload evidence to secure bucket `s3://redwood-sec-evidence/q1-2026` and include SHA256 checksum in the ticket.

maria: Uploaded initial evidence bundle (sha256: abcdef123456...). Will triage the cross-account grant now and post results in 2 hours. Thanks all.
